products.overview: Scale up evaporation without overcomplicating your setup.
features: 20 L Evaporating Flask Setup: Supports large-volume evaporation and solvent recovery workflows where smaller benchtop systems are no longer sufficient.
Glassware A Assembly: Includes one descending condenser, one expansion vessel, one 20 L evaporating flask, and one 10 L receiving flask.
Universal Heating Bath: The bath can be used with water or oil, supporting 20 to 100 °C with water and 20 to 180 °C with oil.
Large Bath Capacity: The heating bath holds 18 L water or 14 L oil, supporting larger evaporation runs and stable bath operation.
Programmable Ramps: The control system supports programmable ramps, helping users create repeatable process steps for distillation and solvent recovery.
Detachable 7-Inch Touch Panel: A detachable control panel with illuminated displays and control knobs helps users monitor and adjust process parameters.
Receiver Cassettes: Receiver cassettes help protect against the threat of receiving flask breakage during handling and operation.
Integrated Refill Water System: The integrated refill water system is included as standard and supports more convenient bath operation.
Spillover Prevention: Spillover prevention helps manage bath fluid overflow risk during large-scale use.
Bottom Release Valve: The bottom release valve makes bath draining and cleaning easier during fluid changeover or maintenance.
Optional Base Cart: A maneuverable base cart can be added for mobility and storage of pump, glassware, solvents, or accessories.
IQ/OQ Certification Availability: Installation qualification and operating qualification documentation are available where GMP-related documentation is required.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator is used for large-volume solvent recovery, pilot-scale distillation, process concentration, and evaporation workflows where a benchtop rotary evaporator is too small.

faqs.question: What is the exact configuration of this product?
faqs.answer: The confirmed configuration is Hei-VAP Industrial B with glassware A, P/N 518-23100-00. It includes one descending condenser, one expansion vessel, one 20 L evaporating flask, and one 10 L receiving flask.

faqs.question: What is Glassware A in the Hei-VAP Industrial Basic?
faqs.answer: Glassware A is the supplied glassware assembly for this configuration. It includes a descending condenser, expansion vessel, 20 L evaporating flask, and 10 L receiving flask.

faqs.question: What batch size can the Hei-VAP Industrial Basic handle?
faqs.answer: This configuration includes a 20 L evaporating flask and a 10 L receiving flask. Final working volume should be decided based on solvent behaviour, foaming, vacuum level, and operator procedure.

faqs.question: How is Hei-VAP Industrial Basic different from Hei-VAP Industrial?
faqs.answer: The Industrial Basic keeps the core industrial evaporation platform but does not include selected enclosure-based safety features such as the metal frame and safety glass guard hood, PMMA glassware assembly door, and PMMA latching doors for receiving flask cassettes.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAP Industrial Basic have programmable ramps?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes a large touch screen control panel with illuminated process displays and programmable ramps for repeatable evaporation workflows.

faqs.question: What is the heating bath volume?
faqs.answer: The heating bath volume is 18 L with water and 14 L with oil.

faqs.question: What is the heating bath temperature range?
faqs.answer: The heating bath supports 20 to 100 °C with water and 20 to 180 °C with oil.

faqs.question: What pump capacity is required?
faqs.answer: The required pump capacity is 1.5 to 3 m³/h. Pump selection should be reviewed based on solvent, batch volume, desired vacuum level, and operating conditions.

faqs.question: What cooling liquid consumption is required?
faqs.answer: The listed cooling liquid consumption is 150 to 250 L/h. Cooling availability should be checked before installation.

faqs.question: Is IQ/OQ certification available?
faqs.answer: Yes. IQ/OQ certification is available for this model where installation and operating qualification documentation is required.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help plan the complete setup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help review solvent type, batch volume, vacuum pump, cooling setup, bath fluid, installation space, optional base cart, safety scope, IQ/OQ documentation, training, spares, AMC, and service requirements.

longForm.heroLead: Scale up evaporation without overcomplicating your setup. When benchtop evaporation is no longer enough, the Heidolph Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator helps laboratories move into larger batch volumes with a practical, cost-focused industrial configuration. The confirmed configuration is Hei-VAP Industrial B with glassware A, P/N 518-23100-00. It includes one descending condenser, one expansion vessel, one 20 L evaporating flask, and one 10 L receiving flask. It is designed for teams handling larger solvent volumes, pilot-scale distillation, solvent recovery, and concentration workflows where bath capacity, vacuum performance, cooling supply, and safe handling all need to be planned together.

sections.title: Built for the move from lab scale to larger batches
sections.description: The Hei-VAP Industrial Basic is for laboratories that have outgrown small rotary evaporators and need a more capable setup for larger solvent volumes.
sections.subheading: Large-volume evaporation, planned around your utilities
body: The Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories and pilot-scale facilities that need to process larger solvent volumes without moving directly into a fully enclosed industrial evaporation system.

This configuration, Hei-VAP Industrial B with glassware A, gives users a large-volume evaporation setup with a 20 L evaporating flask, 10 L receiving flask, descending condenser, expansion vessel, universal heating bath, receiver cassettes, programmable ramps, and a detachable 7-inch touch panel with control knobs.

The Basic version keeps the core industrial evaporation capability while reducing selected enclosure-based safety elements found in the full Hei-VAP Industrial model. This makes it suitable for labs that need scale, repeatability, and configuration flexibility, but also need to manage investment carefully.

Inkarp helps customers review the complete setup before purchase, including solvent type, batch volume, vacuum pump capacity, cooling liquid supply, bath fluid, installation space, optional base cart, IQ/OQ documentation, operator training, and long-term service needs.
